card.name: Annals of Internal Medicine and linking words
card.fires_on: Mainly on 'Ann' (and 'of') in the journal name Annals of Internal Medicine in news citations. Also on small words like 'a' or 'or' before 'known potential' or 'strong' CYP3A inhibitor phrases in interaction text.

modes.label: Annals journal name
modes.description: The start of the journal title Annals of Internal Medicine, or the word 'of' inside it, or the author name Ann.
modes.example: The study and editorial appear in the June 21 issue of the<< Ann>>als of Internal Medicine.

modes.label: Linking word before interaction terms
modes.description: A small word such as 'a' or 'or' after 'with' or 'moderate', leading into strength or potential of a drug effect.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of KRAZATI with other products with<< a>> known potential to prolong the QTc interval
